excerpt:
CSET’s Hanna Dohmen shared her expert insight in an article published by The Wall Street Journal. The article examines the United States’ reliance on foreign-made memory chips and how proposed tariffs could complicate efforts to expand domestic semiconductor production as AI demand drives prices higher.

The post America Is Behind on Memory Chips—and Tariffs Threaten to Make Things Harder appeared first on Center for Security and Emerging Technology.
